Job Summary 
 LTM is seeking a Specialist - Cloud Engineering to lead digital workplace and end-user services strategy, driving scalable hybrid cloud solutions, endpoint collaboration, and virtual workspaces to elevate enterprise productivity and operational excellence. 
 
 Job Details 
 Job Title: Specialist - Cloud Engineering Location: Navi Mumbai Experience: 5-7 years 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Define the digital workplace vision, service portfolio, reference architecture, roadmap, standards, and experience-led operating model across enterprise environments. Architect endpoint management strategies for Windows, macOS, mobile, rugged devices, kiosks, and shared devices using on-premises and cloud-native management platforms. Design and govern Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity services, including collaboration, email, meeting rooms, telephony integration, file sharing, and user adoption. Lead modern management initiatives including Autopilot or equivalent provisioning, application packaging, software distribution, patching, compliance, endpoint analytics, and device lifecycle. Design VDI/DaaS and application virtualization across on-premises platforms and cloud services, addressing profile identity, image management, capacity, and resilience patterns. Embed zero trust, conditional access, encryption, DLP, endpoint detection, least privilege, secure browser, and compliance controls in collaboration with security teams. Manage OEMs, software vendors, managed service providers, licensing contracts, adoption financials, and service-level outcomes to optimize enterprise value. 
 
 Qualifications

Comprehensive expertise in Microsoft 365 Suites of Products, covering email, meetings, collaboration, file sharing, and adoption methodologies. Hands-on experience in virtual workspace architectures including VDI, DaaS, application virtualization, user profiles, image management, capacity planning, and user experience optimization. Proven knowledge of identity security frameworks such as Active Directory, cloud identity, MFA, conditional access, EDR, encryption, DLP, and privileged endpoint controls. Strong background in leadership, enterprise strategy, architecture, governance, transformation programs, vendor management, and executive communication. 
 
 Preferred 
 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, complemented by relevant practical experience in complex enterprise environments. Industry certifications such as Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator or Architect, Azure Virtual Desktop or equivalent VDI certification, ITIL Foundation, or Security/Identity credentials. Strong domain expertise in digital workplace services, coupled with exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, presentation, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Mechanical Design Engineer to support the design, development, and improvement of wrapping machines and other special-purpose machinery. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in mechanical machine design, automation, fabrication, and the development of cost-effective engineering solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design and develop wrapping machines, special-purpose machines, and End-of-Line Automation systems. Prepare 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, and assembly drawings using CAD software, preferably Solid Edge. Design machine frames, sheet-metal components, bent metal parts, and welded assemblies. Develop and integrate pneumatic systems, actuators, sensors, and mechanical automation components. Understand automation control concepts and coordinate with electrical and controls engineers for machine integration. Apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and cost-optimization principles. Select suitable mechanical and pneumatic components based on functionality, performance, availability, and cost. Coordinate with manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, suppliers, and service teams to resolve technical issues. Support machine assembly, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous product improvement. Ensure designs meet requirements for safety, reliability, ease of maintenance, and manufacturability. 
 Skills: Strong mechanical design and machine development skills. Good knowledge of automation control systems and End-of-Line Automation. Experience in metal sheet bending, fabrication, welded assemblies, and machine structures. Proficiency in Solid Edge CAD software is an added advantage. Knowledge of pneumatic systems and component selection. Basic understanding of electrical diagrams, sensors, actuators, and mechatronics. Ability to develop economical, practical, and manufacturable design solutions. Good English communication skills. Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams. 
 Experience: 3-10 years of relevant experience in wrapping machines, special-purpose machinery, packaging machinery, or End-of-Line Automation. Candidates with substantial hands-on experience may be considered irrespective of formal educational qualifications.

Key Skills: Sensors,CAD,Mechatronics,Industrial,Mechanical design,Edge,Fabrication,Sensor
